name: agent-driven-architecture-ts
//workspaces: Fourteen packages, none published — the spine, a PAIR per block (pure unit and adapter leaf, both inside the block's own folder) and the composition root. The blocks are the wall; the spine is the vendored template packaged internally for it. `npm install` links them all into the single root node_modules, which is exactly why one cross-block route stays open - recorded above C2 in eslint.config.js.
description: Functional TypeScript reference implementation of the Agent-Driven Architecture, on the Vercel AI SDK.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run biome && vitest run

//typecheck: TWO checks, both blocking. `tsc --noEmit` is the whole-tree program - src, test and the gate itself still cohere. `typecheck:wall` builds the fourteen package programs - the spine, a PAIR per block and the composition root - where rootDir is the package folder and `references` is the permission list; that is the run in which a cross-block reach is a resolution error rather than a lint message. It runs through scripts/wall.mjs rather than calling tsc directly because `tsc -b` is a BUILD: on the RED path it emits beside the source, and a failed run must not be able to change the verdict of the next one.
